V primeru skupne ponudbe lahko pogoj partnerji izpolnijo skupaj. V primeru, da ponudnik nastopa s podizvajalci, lahko pogoj ponudnik in podizvajalci dokazujejo skupno. DOKAZILO: - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz prve alineje prvega odstavka te točke: Izpolnjen obrazec P- 10 Referenca ponudnika. Referenca mora biti potrjena s strani naročnika referenčnega posla s podpisom. V kolikor se referenca nanaša na naročnika (Ministrstvo za zunanje in evropske zadeve), ponudnik izpolni vse podatke, vendar podpis reference s strani naročnika ni potreben. - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz druge alineje prvega odstavka te točke: ustrezna navedba v točki 3 obrazca P-2 Prijava in dokazila o izkušnjah ter sodelovanju strokovnjaka (npr. pogodba o zaposlitvi). 9.4.2 Vsi kadri ponudnika, ki bodo opravljali dela predmetnega javnega naročila, bodo varnostno preverjeni s strani naročnika v skladu z 16a. členom Zakona o zunanjih zadevah (Uradni list RS št. 113/03– uradno prečiščeno besedilo, s spremembami in dopolnitvami, v nadaljevanju ZZZ-1). This is a nonpersonal services contract requesting software development of Autonomy Government Reference Architecture (A-GRA) interfaces for the Mission Termination System (MTS), yielding a Technology Readiness Level 9 (TRL 9) product . MTS is a Run Time Assurance (RTA) tool based on the Testing Autonomy in Complex Environments (TACE) code base created by Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Lab (JHU APL). MTS is used at Edwards AFB to safely test autonomous control of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The government shall not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers performing the services herein. Such contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the contractor who, in turn, is responsible to the government. 1.1.1 Description of Services/Objectives. The contractor shall be responsible for providing RealSAM Dialog licenses and services required to operate the system in production, while meeting all IT information-system security requirements as required by the Library of Congress. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. This service is also extended to eligible American citizens residing abroad.
